pages.text: Jesus walked along the Sea of Galilee. He saw two fishermen, Simon and Andrew, throwing their nets into the water.
Jesus said, "Come, follow me. I will make you fishers of people." Right away, they left their nets and followed Him.
Jesus called James and John, too, and later chose twelve friends in all. They were the apostles, and they learned from Jesus every day.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Jesus calls each of us to follow Him. The apostles helped start His Church.

stories.title: Friends Bring a Man to Jesus

pages.text: Jesus was teaching in a house, and so many people came that no one else could fit inside. Four friends carried their friend, who could not walk, on a mat.
They could not get through the crowd, so they climbed on the roof, made an opening and lowered their friend down in front of Jesus!
Jesus saw their faith. He said to the man, "Your sins are forgiven." Then He said, "Stand up, take your mat and go home."
At once the man stood up, picked up his mat and walked out, praising God! Everyone was amazed. Jesus has the power to heal and to forgive.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Four friends helped a man get to Jesus. We can bring our friends and family to Jesus, too.

pages.text: One evening Jesus said to His friends, "Let us cross to the other side of the lake." Jesus was tired, so He fell asleep in the back of the boat.
Suddenly a great storm came up. Waves filled the boat! The friends woke Jesus and cried, "Teacher, do You not care that we are about to drown?"
Jesus stood up and said to the wind and the sea, "Peace! Be still!" The wind stopped, and everything was calm. His friends said, "Even the wind and sea obey Him!"

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Jesus is stronger than any storm. We can trust Him when we are scared.

pages.text: A blind man named Bartimaeus sat by the road outside Jericho, begging. When he heard that Jesus was passing by, he shouted, "Jesus, have mercy on me!"
Many people told him to be quiet, but he shouted even louder. Jesus stopped and said, "Call him." Bartimaeus threw off his cloak and jumped up.
Jesus asked, "What do you want me to do for you?" "Lord, I want to see!" said Bartimaeus. Jesus said, "Go, your faith has saved you." Right away, he could see, and he followed Jesus.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Bartimaeus did not give up. He kept calling to Jesus, and Jesus heard him.
